comment: Luz27 is a membrane-bound acyltransferase that mediates the subsequent O-acetylation extracellularly.

reactions.description: Luz27 performs stepwise O-acetylations on the 4-OH groups of 4-OH-Thp residues to afford a final product, luzopeptin A
Luz27, a membrane-bound acyltransferase performs stepwise O-acetylations at the 4-OH groups in di-deacetylated derivative luzopeptin C to afford luzopeptin A, using acetyl-CoA as the acetyl donor
